title: Rabbi Yissa bei Rabbi Shabtai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 9:7. Hyman thinks the reading should be Rabbi Yissa in Rabbi Shabtai’s name. He points to Bava Batra 163a, where Rabbi Shabtai reports Chizkiyah, and to Gittin 26b as a parallel.

notes.text: The consulted Bava Batra paragraph has Rabbi Shabtai reporting Chizkiyah, correcting the reversed chain in the earlier English. The heading’s bei is kept apart from Hyman’s proposed “in the name of.”

The consulted Yerushalmi retains bei. Bava Batra 163a explicitly has Shabtai report Chizkiyah about the two lines. Gittin 26b places Shabtai and Chizkiyah together in a discussion of a quarrel and witnesses. Hyman proposes the reporting formula and draws the parallel.
